name: CABALL: Innocence
source:
Michelle receives an invitation from her grandfather, who had avoided her for years. But instead of a family celebration, she finds a grim reality, and the night erupts in violence. Fleeing, she finds refuge and the one her soul had been seeking.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3038270/CABALL_Innocence/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
米歇尔收到了多年来一直刻意疏远她的祖父寄来的邀请函。然而等待她的并非温馨的家族庆典，而是残酷阴冷的现实——整片黑夜骤然陷入血腥暴力之中。在亡命奔逃的路上，她找到了一处庇护之所，也邂逅了自己灵魂苦苦追寻至今的那个人。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3038270/CABALL_Innocence/]Steam[/url]]
